name: Keluhu
title: Descendants of the Priests in Ezra's Time
summary: Keluhu (also spelled Keluhi or Keluhu) was one of the Levites mentioned in connection with the renewal of the covenant under Nehemiah. He was among those who sealed the agreement to follow God's law after returning from exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Covenant Renewal under Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Keluhu was among the Levites who sealed the covenant to obey God's law and keep His commandments after returning from the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: The People's Repentance and Confession
keyEvents.description: In connection with the renewal of the covenant, Keluhu joined other Levites in a solemn assembly where the people confessed their sins and committed themselves to follow the Lord's law.

keyEvents.title: Reading of the Law and Worship
keyEvents.description: As part of the Levitical community, Keluhu was involved in the public reading of God's law and the subsequent worship that took place in Jerusalem after the rebuilding of the walls.

keyEvents.title: Commitment to Remain Separate
keyEvents.description: Keluhu was among those who pledged to keep God's people separate from the surrounding nations and to follow the law given through Moses.
